_comment: nemotron-labs-unified-asr-0.6b: parakeet.json plus the language prompt MLP.
Prompted tensors: 1.5x the drift observed on jfk (en) and fleurs-de (de) against
NeMo @ 6967f48f offline (max 1.78e-2, mean 4.03e-4); both transcripts match exactly.
Full-attention checkpoints run NeMo's rel_pos_local_attn [256, 256] by
default in C++. Clips whose encoder length fits inside the band (<= 257
frames, ~20.5 s, e.g. jfk) run the full-attention graph and match the
reference's 2T-1 rows exactly. Longer clips carry the local table (513
rows dense, W+C-1 rows bounded-window) while NeMo dumps 2T-1 rows, or
2L+1 under --att-context 256,256. The table is a deterministic sinusoid
input, not an activation; every encoder activation downstream is
compared at full tolerance, and values are compared whenever the shapes
